sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Cottendorfia florida is a terrestrial, rock-dwelling bromeliad from north-eastern Brazil, recorded on rocky slopes around 1,200 m. Its leaf rosette can reach about 1 m tall, and the narrow leaves are up to 12 mm wide.

sections.title: Inflorescence and plate
sections.text: The flowering stalk may reach 2–4 m, far above the rosette; flowers are about 7 mm long. The plate shows the rosette, whitish leaf undersides and very tall inflorescence. No food use has been established.
